analyst_test: With every file conformed and every rule read, the easy route takes the vendor's reported scale scores (each the maximum likelihood estimate from all forty responses on the bank's parameters) and designates the campuses with 35 per cent or more below Basic; but some sessions were rapid-guessed, responses given in a second or two at chance accuracy that carry no information about what the student knows, and scoring each student on the responses given with effort moves several campuses off the list.
domain_test: Effort-moderated item response scoring, the psychometrician's treatment of rapid-guessing in a low-stakes test: a response given faster than any engaged reading of the item is treated as not administered and the student's ability is estimated by maximum likelihood from the responses given with effort; with another field's nouns there is no item response model, no response time and no guessing floor, so the step does not exist.

spine.entity: one student's response to one item

driver: Each unit's level is estimated from its answers to a set of items through a known response model, and in some sittings part of the answers were given too fast to have been read, at the chance rate, so they carry no information; estimating every unit from all its answers pulls the units of those sittings toward the floor, and only the answers given with effort, scored by the same model, recover each unit's level.
driver_concrete: On the spring 2026 benchmark, the students in a few campuses' end-of-day sessions answered a third or more of the items in under three seconds and got a quarter of them right, the rate of a blind guess on four options; the vendor's scores count those guesses as wrong answers and put those campuses over the 35 per cent line, while each student's score from the items answered with effort leaves them under it.
stump: The default path takes the vendor's reported scale scores and designates the campuses with 35 per cent or more of students below Basic, because it never asks whether every response it scores was a real attempt.

lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-21 at stage 4: a reader landed the call by reading guidelines 3.1's 'would bring ... as they stand' literally and replaying each claim's water on the present floor; judge FIX_NOW on ask B
lineage.driver: A record of past events on units is carried to the units as they now stand, and some units were raised after their events, so a past event counts again on a raised unit only where the event's recorded level stood above the unit's new threshold; dropping a raised unit's earlier events, keeping them all, or giving it the later rate of units in its present class each misstates the expected rate.
lineage.stump: The default path drops every claim a building filed before it was elevated and puts the two riverine counties elevated after 2016 in the pilot, because it never asks whether the 2016 water would still have reached the raised floors.

lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-21 at stage 4: both scored readers (target.zip 7d73c6a44d3464b7) landed the call (score_reader exit 1, 50 and 54 of 80 ask figures) by computing each county's Department-to-Monitor ratio for every published year and extrapolating its visible linear drift; both also found the register county and the crosswalk gaps
lineage.driver: A total for a period not yet counted is carried from the last complete count by the movement of a fixed sample, and the sample covers a shrinking share of the whole because new members join only the whole, at a pace that differs by area and has held steady through every counted period; carrying the last count by the sample's movement, or scaling the sample by the last count's ratio to it, drops one more period of that drift, so the ratio must be carried forward on its own path.
lineage.stump: The default path moves each county's 2024 Department receipts by its member panel's 2025 growth and qualifies Arvenne, Brisholt, Corrigan Bay and Delvane, because it never asks how the panel's growth has tracked the Department's in the years both are known.
